independent_coordinates.validation: Fit and prediction standard errors checked at absolute tolerance 2e-8, including Haswell BLAS.

retained_degenerate_coordinates.input: Original stream restarted at seed515 for x2; hence x2 equals .625*x0 to floating-point roundoff.
retained_degenerate_coordinates.limitation: The three-dimensional thin-plate polynomial locations are rank deficient. Exact fitted behavior was not established across BLAS implementations: Haswell differed by .00334326 on held-out fit values. This snapshot is retained as evidence, not a strict behavioral parity claim. Runtime tests compare source deletion counts, degrees of freedom and penalty ranks only.
